description: Static onboarding guide for connecting local LLMs to MMIR.ai through a safe local connector. The actual connector is owned by mmir-local-node.

steps.title: Install local connector
steps.description: Download a small MMIR connector app or script from the local-node project. It should run locally and expose only a controlled connector API, not raw model runtimes.

steps.title: Detect local models
steps.description: The connector discovers supported local runtimes such as Ollama and returns available models through the MMIR /models contract.

steps.title: Pair with MMIR.ai
steps.description: The frontend should pair with the local connector before model/chat control. It stores only the local connector URL and safe profile metadata.

steps.title: Chat safely
steps.description: MMIR routes chat requests through /chat/completions. Raw Ollama port 11434 should not be exposed publicly.

security: No secrets in GitHub Pages frontend
Local connector should require explicit local user action
Allow users to disconnect and delete local profiles
